import ctypes
import tempfile
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_permutation structure
class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t), ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)

gsl.gsl_permutation_fwrite.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
gsl.gsl_permutation_fwrite.restype = ctypes.c_int

gsl.gsl_permutation_fread.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
gsl.gsl_permutation_fread.restype = ctypes.c_int

gsl.gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]

def write_and_read_permutation(perm_list):
    n = len(perm_list)
    
    # Handle empty permutation case
    if n == 0:
        return []
    
    perm = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    if not perm:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to allocate permutation")
    
    # Initialize the permutation data
    for i in range(n):
        perm.contents.data[i] = perm_list[i]
    
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as tmp:
        tmpname = tmp.name
    
    try:
        # Use libc's fopen/fclose for file operations
        libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6")
        libc.fopen.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        libc.fopen.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        libc.fclose.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        
        # Write to file
        file_ptr = libc.fopen(tmpname.encode(), b"wb")
        if not file_ptr:
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to open file for writing")
        
        result = gsl.gsl_permutation_fwrite(file_ptr, perm)
        libc.fclose(file_ptr)
        if result != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"gsl_permutation_fwrite failed with error code {result}")
        
        # Reset the permutation for reading
        for i in range(n):
            perm.contents.data[i] = 0
        
        # Read from file
        file_ptr = libc.fopen(tmpname.encode(), b"rb")
        if not file_ptr:
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to open file for reading")
        
        result = gsl.gsl_permutation_fread(file_ptr, perm)
        libc.fclose(file_ptr)
        if result != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"gsl_permutation_fread failed with error code {result}")
        
        read_list = [perm.contents.data[i] for i in range(n)]
        return read_list
    finally:
        gsl.gsl_permutation_free(perm)
        os.unlink(tmpname)

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Normal permutation
    input_perm = [2, 0, 1, 3]
    output_perm = write_and_read_permutation(input_perm)
    assert input_perm == output_perm, f"Expected {input_perm}, got {output_perm}"
    
    # Test case 2: Single element
    input_perm = [0]
    output_perm = write_and_read_permutation(input_perm)
    assert input_perm == output_perm, f"Expected {input_perm}, got {output_perm}"
    
    # Test case 3: Larger permutation
    input_perm = [4, 3, 2, 1, 0]
    output_perm = write_and_read_permutation(input_perm)
    assert input_perm == output_perm, f"Expected {input_perm}, got {output_perm}"
    
    # Test case 4: Empty permutation (edge case) - handled separately
    input_perm = []
    output_perm = write_and_read_permutation(input_perm)
    assert input_perm == output_perm, f"Expected {input_perm}, got {output_perm}"
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
